title: publicgenai
summary: A Jupyter notebook coursework project (Task18) that experiments with generating synthetic fraud transaction data using multiple generative models. It builds a metadata schema and fits SDV's TVAESynthesizer alongside a standalone CTGAN model to produce synthetic fraud records for comparison.
